name: tech-tools
description: Claude Code plugins: atlas (a verification-first multi-agent coding architect), armada (an optional organization layer with department agents and vendor connectors), and programmer (code review based on The Pragmatic Programmer).

plugins.name: atlas
plugins.description: Multi-agent coding architect for Claude Code: plans, delegates to named subagents, verifies with evidence, and blocks 'done' until the evidence exists.

plugins.name: armada
plugins.description: Optional organization layer for atlas: 4 setup skills, 11 department agents, 156 department skills, and 13 vendor MCP connectors that stay off until credentials are set in plugin config. Install alongside atlas.

plugins.name: programmer
plugins.description: Code review and principles advice based on The Pragmatic Programmer: 4 skills and 7 agents (6 code-review lens reviewers plus tpp-auditor).
